subject: RE: Your Communication with Companies House, Ref: COH2382411X
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text: Dear Companies House,  Re: COH2382411X and my preservation and supply request of 10 October 2026  Thank you for your reply of 12 October. I need to identify and examine three records urgently to test the title history and rule out suspected fraud or concealment. I do not allege wrongdoing by any recipient:  1. A reported 1926 conveyance to Cardiff Corporation, including its plan; 2. The 1926 formation and company records for Mountjoy Ltd / Mountjoy Limited, associated with the Bute estate; 3. The 1938 Bute or Mountjoy conveyance to Western Ground Rents Ltd, including its plan. A 1965 school-site contract refers to a conveyance on sale dated 25 December 1938; its parties and extent remain to be checked.  Please confirm or correct each identification, including the correct Mountjoy company number and the identity of Western Ground Rents Ltd connected to the 1938 sale. My enquiry of 20 October used company number 00342092; your 12 October reply gave 09760885. Please check whether these refer to different companies and identify the correct historical company.  For each record, please say whether you hold or have held it, including copies, indexes and predecessor or archive files; the current custodian, location, series and reference; whether any retention, preservation, litigation hold or stop applies; and who else may have handled or copied it. Please identify the registers, indexes, systems and dates searched, and any destruction or transfer record. If held, please provide a copy or explain the free inspection route and any charge before work is undertaken.  Please preserve the records and related indexes, including electronic and archived material, and do not destroy or dispose of them or transfer them without a recorded handover while my enquiry is open. Please confirm whether a hold is in place.  The site is Great House Farm / Great House / Greathouse / Tŷ Mawr / Ty Mawr / Ty-mawr / Ty Mawr Farm, beside St Dochdwy's Church, Llandough-juxta-Penarth near Penarth and Cardiff, later Church View Close. Please also search Llandough Home Farm, Land Doc Home Farm, Cydfin, Cedfin, Cydwin, Cedwyn, Cedfyn, Cefin, Church Farm, Llandough Church Farm, Llandough Farm, Bute Estate, Mountjoy, Western Ground Rents, Landoche-juxta-Cardif, Llandochau, Leckwith and Penarth. These are search leads, not proof of a shared title; please distinguish the separate Llandough Farm and exclude Llandough near Cowbridge. The complete farm, estate and locality search forms and their qualifications are at https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/nomenclature/  Thank you for your help.  Yours faithfully,  Requester (Ret'd Sergeant)  https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate
